description: Secretariat of the Governor - Eastern Province - Delegation of powers to the Assistant Commissioner of Ampara District
categorisation: The gazette content is about a structural/administrative change within a provincial government framework. It authorizes the Assistant Commissioner of Local Government to perform specific financial and administrative duties for a local authority (Nindavur Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a vacancy in the Chairman's office. The focus is on the assignment of functions and duties (financial administration, project implementation) to a government office/position. No specific individual is appointed, promoted, or named in the authorization; the Assistant Commissioner is referenced by title only. This fits the definition of an Organisational Gazette (Type 1), which covers government structural changes without naming specific people for personnel changes.
